== Summary ==
Published-layout comparison for [[Relatively Unprotected (Errata 3)]]. Left: [[:File:V9-L-relativelyunprotected.gif]], with exterior top padding cropped. Right: [[:File:V9-L-relativelyunprotected-Set9-October-2023-partial.png]], using its original PDF mask. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original images published by the Players Committee.
